subject: Phone screen with Anya Petrov — timezone and calendar check

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Quick: 20-min phone screen — confirm a slot (PST/CEST)

Hi Anya —

Thanks again for applying to the Platform team. Karthik (hiring manager) and I would love to do a quick 20-minute phone screen to go over background and role fit.

I wanted to offer a few windows that work on our side — I included both PST and what those times look like in CEST to avoid timezone confusion. Please reply with the option that works best or propose two alternatives.

- Wed 8 Dec — 9:30–9:50 AM PST / 18:30–18:50 CEST
- Wed 8 Dec — 11:00–11:20 AM PST / 20:00–20:20 CEST
- Thu 9 Dec — 8:00–8:20 AM PST / 17:00–17:20 CEST

If none of these fit, tell me your timezone and a couple of 30-minute windows and I’ll sync calendars.

Also: feel free to attach your most recent resume (we have a copy but want the latest version).

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Recruiter | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai

Attachment: (none)

From: Anya Petrov <anya.petrov@gmail.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 23:45:12 +0100
Subject: Re: Quick: 20-min phone screen — confirm a slot

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks — excited to chat. I’m currently in Prague (CET). The times above help, but I want to confirm: when you wrote CEST for Dec 8, do you mean CET (no DST in December)? I don’t want to miss the slot because of a DST mix-up.

I’m available Wed 8 Dec at 18:30 CET (which would be 9:30 AM PST) or Thu 9 Dec at 17:00 CET (8:00 AM PST). Either works for me. I attached my resume in case you want the version I used for the application.

Thanks,
Anya
+420 602 555 012
Attachment: anya_petrov_resume.pdf

Stephanie —

Thanks for looping me in and thanks to Anya for the quick reply. Good catch on the DST/CET vs CEST difference. We should stick to CET for December.

I’m available Wed 8 Dec at 9:30 AM PST (18:30 CET) — that works for me. Can you send a calendar invite to lock the slot? Also, I’ll prep a short list of behavioral questions and a couple notes on the technical signals we’re prioritizing.

Karthik

- Time: Wed, Dec 8, 2026 — 9:30 AM PST / 18:30 CET (20 minutes)
